## ✨ Highlights

- 🖥️ **`janusctl tui`: events and logs are two panels** - 7 the events, 8 the log, 9 the modules: each its own digit, focus and scroll, where both used to be one panel 7 drawn as two boxes. And `janusctl tui -theme list` no longer needs a node.
- 📖 **The go-uefi finding of the 2026-09-30 audit is public**: `github.com/foxboron/go-uefi`'s Authenticode verification accepted a signature grafted from another binary. Reported privately to its maintainer on 2026-09-30, fixed upstream on 2026-10-04; Janus was never exposed - it makes every check itself - and now builds with the fixed library. See [the audit, #17](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/security-audit-2026-09-30.md).

## 🖥️ The dashboard in the terminal

- **Events (7), logs (8), modules (9)**: the node screen's bottom was one panel, 7, shown as two boxes both labelled 7 - `7` hid both, neither could be hidden alone. Each is now its own panel (`1-9 panels` in the footer): side by side from 120 columns, the other taking the width when one is hidden; on a narrower terminal, the one `e`, `l` or the focus chose - `Tab` walks to the events, then to the log, and shows it; `l` again switches janusd's log and HAProxy's. Each scrolls on its own.
- **`janusctl tui -theme list`** prints the themes without a context or a certificate (it went through the connection to a node first), and an unknown `-theme` is refused before anything is dialled.

## 📦 Upstreams

- **`github.com/foxboron/go-uefi`** to `v0.0.0-20261004203234-c7f1f57bdc6e`, its Authenticode fix ([c7f1f57](https://github.com/Foxboron/go-uefi/commit/c7f1f57bdc6ea27b519ea19e3fa4deeff05dacbe)). Only janusd uses it, to read and hash the kernel images an upgrade or an install checks; `internal/releasetrust` makes the trust decision itself and keeps doing so, now with a test that grafts a signature and checks both Janus and the library refuse it.

## 📖 Docs

- [Security audit of 2026-09-30](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/blob/main/docs/security-audit-2026-09-30.md): finding #17 - go-uefi's `authenticode.Verify` didn't check that the signed `messageDigest` matches the signed content; its cause, a demonstration, why Janus wasn't exposed, the disclosure's dates and the fix.
- [janusctl](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/janusctl.md#the-dashboard-janusctl-tui): the events and the log, panels 7 and 8.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **janusctl**: `apt update && apt install janusctl`, or the release's `.deb`, for the dashboard's fixes.
- **Nodes**: rebuilt with the fixed go-uefi; what an upgrade or an install accepts doesn't change (Janus's own checks). Update at your pace, the usual A/B update.
- **The Controller, the Terraform provider**: nothing changed.
